answer: A payoff letter isn't strictly required: we confirm what's owed at the appointment and pay the lender directly from our offer, but getting a payoff letter beforehand speeds things up, and if the lender is in our e-payoff network you don't need a letter at all. The help center doesn't say whether Lakeshore Bank is in that network, so please contact a store to check. Because your dad has passed away, also bring his death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator, or the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir, or by every heir if there are several. A power of attorney can't be used, and since the loan is still open, Lakeshore Bank holds the title, so you don't need it in hand.
